title: The Broken Recipe
author: Rafael Whitlock
blurb: Dominic Voss, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
